description: Lean misfire under load. Unmetered air enters through a cracked brake-booster vacuum hose; ECU compensates with rising fuel trims until misfires appear.

discriminators.vacuum_leak: Fuel trims climb strongly with engine load; MAF reads consistently ~10-14% below derived airflow but tracks rpm/load smoothly; O2 leans out under load.
discriminators.maf_fault: MAF reading erratic or implausibly inconsistent with rpm/load, not a smooth proportional offset.
discriminators.ignition_fault: Misfires without lean fuel-trim signature; trims near normal.
discriminators.o2_sensor_fault: O2 voltage flatlined/railed while fuel trims show closed-loop activity.

notes: ground_truth_eval_only is for evaluation scripts only; it is never exposed through any MCP tool.
